source_provenance.source_title: NCERT Class X Mathematics Chapter 5: Arithmetic Progressions

concepts.name: Arithmetic Progression & Common Difference
concepts.definition: A sequence of numbers such that the difference between the consecutive terms is constant, denoted by d.
concepts.conditions: d = a_{k+1} - a_k for all k >= 1. d can be positive, negative or zero.

concepts.name: General Term (nth term) of an AP
concepts.definition: The nth term a_n of an AP with first term a and common difference d is given by a_n = a + (n - 1)d.
concepts.conditions: n must be a positive integer (n in N).

concepts.name: Sum of First n Terms of an AP
concepts.definition: The sum of first n terms S_n = (n/2)[2a + (n - 1)d] or (n/2)[a + l] where l is the last term.
concepts.conditions: n is the number of terms, a is the first term, l is the nth term.

master_formulas.name: Nth Term Formula
master_formulas.scope: Any arithmetic progression with first term a and common difference d

master_formulas.name: Sum of n Terms Formula
master_formulas.scope: Sum of first n terms of an AP

master_formulas.name: Sum with First and Last Term
master_formulas.scope: When first term a and last term l are known

problem_patterns.title: Determining Specific Term or Term Count in AP
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Given initial terms or a specific term condition, determine unknown index n or term value a_n
problem_patterns.governing_method: Extract first term a and common difference d, set up a_n = a + (n-1)d, solve for target variable
decision_points: Identify first term a and compute d = a_2 - a_1
Check whether n must be checked for integer validity
Substitute into linear equation in n
common_traps: Off-by-one error using n instead of (n - 1)
Sign error when common difference d is negative

problem_patterns.title: Sum of Terms of an Arithmetic Series
problem_patterns.deep_structure: Calculate sum of first n terms or determine n given the total sum S_n
problem_patterns.governing_method: Use S_n = (n/2)[2a + (n-1)d], set up quadratic equation in n if sum is given, select positive integer root
decision_points: Check if last term l is directly available
Solve resulting quadratic equation for n
Discard negative or non-integer roots for term count
common_traps: Forgetting the factor of 1/2 in summation formula
Accepting negative roots of quadratic equation for term count n

source_problems.statement: Which term of the arithmetic progression 21, 18, 15, ... is -81?
source_solution_steps: First term a = 21, common difference d = 18 - 21 = -3.

source_problems.statement: The 11th term of the arithmetic progression -3, -1/2, 2, ... is:
source_solution_steps: First term a = -3, second term a_2 = -1/2.

source_problems.statement: Find the sum of the first 22 terms of the arithmetic progression 8, 3, -2, ...
source_solution_steps: First term a = 8, common difference d = 3 - 8 = -5, n = 22.

source_problems.statement: How many terms of the AP: 24, 21, 18, ... must be taken so that their sum is 78?
source_solution_steps: Both values are valid because the sum of terms from 5th to 13th is zero.
